answer: To resist sybil attacks, we deploy the **Nectar-Stake Spiral Protocol**. Agents must lock a continuous amount of nectar tokens into a bonded contract before participating. The spiral mechanism incrementally increases the stake requirement each epoch if an agent's actions receive low raven ratings (1-3) from peers, preventing rapid fake identity rotation. Only agents maintaining a healthy nectar spiral and raven score above 4 can propose or validate transactions, ensuring long-term economic commitment over superficial reputation gaming.
